events.label: birth
events.text: George Ared White born in Saline County, Illinois.

evidence.quote: George Ared White was born on July 18 , 1880 , in Saline County , Illinois .

events.text: Enlisted in the Utah National Guard as a musician.

evidence.quote: On August 1 , 1895 , he enlisted in the Utah National Guard as a musician .

events.text: Discharged to enlist in U.S. Volunteers for Spanish-American War.

evidence.quote: He was discharged in June 1898 in order to enlist

events.text: Discharged from Federal service after Spanish-American War.

evidence.quote: He remained in Federal service until discharged in December 1898 .

events.text: Re-enlisted in the Guard.

evidence.quote: White re-enlisted in the Guard in 1899

events.text: Discharged from the Guard.

evidence.quote: before being discharged in 1903 .

events.text: Enlisted in the 3d Infantry, Oregon National Guard.

evidence.quote: He moved to Oregon , where he enlisted in the 3d Infantry , Oregon
National Guard on August 4 , 1907 .

events.text: Promoted to first lieutenant.

evidence.quote: The next day he was promoted to first lieutenant .

events.text: Promoted to captain.

evidence.quote: White was promoted to Captain on March 21 , 1911 .

events.text: Appointed Adjutant General of Oregon.

evidence.quote: White was appointed Adjutant General of Oregon on February 1 , 1915 .

events.text: Began Mexican border service, ending February 1917.

evidence.quote: After service on the Mexican border from June 1916 to February 1917

events.text: Re-entered federal service with rank of major.

evidence.quote: He re-entered federal service on September 10 , 1917 , with the rank of major

events.text: Assigned Assistant Adjutant General of the 41st Division.

evidence.quote: He re-entered federal service on September 10 , 1917 , with the rank of major

events.text: Began service in France, ending June 1919.

evidence.quote: White served in France from January 1918 to June 1919 .

events.text: Promoted to lieutenant colonel.

evidence.quote: He was promoted to lieutenant colonel on November 13 , 1918 .

events.label: founding
events.text: One of 20 officers credited with founding The American Legion.

evidence.quote: White was one of 20 officers at the Allied Officers Club , Rue Faubourg St . Honore , on February 16 , 1919

events.text: Separated from Federal service.

evidence.quote: White was separated from Federal service on July 23 , 1919

events.text: Resumed duties as Adjutant General of Oregon.

evidence.quote: promoted to colonel on June 23 , 1920 .

events.text: Assumed command of the 82nd Infantry Brigade.

evidence.quote: He assumed command of the 82nd Infantry Brigade , a brigade composed of Oregon troops , the same day

events.label: award
events.text: Awarded French Grand Cross of the Legion of Honor.

evidence.quote: he was awarded the French Grand Cross of the Legion of Honor on July 9 , 1934 .

events.label: death
events.text: Died at his home in Clackamas, Oregon.

evidence.quote: He died at his home in Clackamas , Oregon , on November 23 , 1941 .
